title: “ChatGPT, Don’t Tell Me What to Do”: Designing AI for Context Analysis in Humanitarian Frontline Negotiations

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative semi-structured interviews and a comparative probe study where frontline humanitarian negotiators interacted with ChatGPT and a custom LLM interface using real-world case files, identifying and reporting on Western-centric assumptions and a lack of cultural nuance in the models' negotiation strategies.

Qualitative interviews evaluating the accessibility of LLMs, where participants highlighted that the models reflect the high English proficiency of their Western creators, creating usability barriers for locally recruited staff in non-Western contexts who may not possess advanced English skills.
